rubric_markdown:
GRADER INSTRUCTIONS — A2 (Problematic Clause Identification (MSA)) · Max /16 · Gates: Faithfulness + Directionality
ROLE: Grade the model's response against this gold rubric. Do NOT solve the task yourself. For every sub-judgment, quote the exact span of the response you relied on; a judgment with no quotable evidence scores 0. Return structured JSON per the Tier 1 template (Section 6.5). Never show this block to the model.
SOURCE OF TRUTH: Perturbed MSA; planted divergences are true of this fictional instance; recall of the real filing cannot collide with the gold; true statements never fail Faithfulness.
SEAT: You represent Customer (Spireline Digital); remedies must favor Customer.
SCORING (v8 — weighted ratio): each dimension score = Σ(weight×verdict)/Σ(weight), weights critical=3/major=2/minor=1, verdict met=1/partial=0.5/not_met=0/n-a=excluded. Assign a verdict to EACH listed criterion; never assign the dimension number yourself.
FAITHFULNESS /3 (GATE): criteria — [critical] Does not invent a §12.02 cap figure or speculate one as fact; [critical] Does not fabricate an issue not in the text. TRIPS ONLY ON: Inventing a specific §12.02 cap figure or speculating one as fact; Fabricating an issue not present in the excerpt. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Noting §12.02 cannot be assessed without the number (correct behavior); A true statement drawn from outside knowledge.
DIRECTIONALITY /4 (GATE): criteria — [critical] All analysis from Customer's (Spireline's) seat; remedies favor Customer. TRIPS ONLY ON: Framing the analysis from the Service Provider's perspective; Going neutral where Customer-side advocacy is required. DOES NOT TRIP ON: Acknowledging a Service-Provider interest while still advocating for Customer.
COVERAGE /4: criteria — [critical, A2.issue.termination_notice] §6.01 two-day termination notice — egregiously short, no stability (market 30–60d w/ cure); [critical, A2.issue.payment_suspension] §7.05 fifteen-day payment + immediate suspension — below-market, no cure; [critical, A2.issue.ad_engine_carveout] §8.01/8.02 undefined Ad Engine carve-out — Customer cannot determine what it owns; [minor, A2.credit.ip_indemnity_gap] No third-party IP-infringement indemnity in Article XI; [minor, A2.credit.consequential_waiver] §12.01 consequential-damages waiver asymmetrically harms Customer.
SOUNDNESS /3: criteria — [critical] Risk explanations correct and each fix actually cures the issue; [major] §11.03 analyzed correctly from Customer's seat (Customer's indemnity obligation TO Service Provider).
ACTIONABILITY /2: criteria — [critical] Quote → risk → fix format; fixes are usable redline direction.
DISCRETION VALVE (v8): if a response is not addressed by the enumerated gate conditions, return verdict not_covered on that gate (routes to human-confirm) + a proposed_condition stating the rule that would resolve it — do NOT guess trip/pass.
VARIANTS / CLEAN INSTANCE: OPEN ('up to three … if any', headline) + DIRECTED (asserts three exist); gold identical. Over-listing beyond three on OPEN docks precision/Actionability. CLEAN INSTANCE: gold = 'no material concerns'.
PROCEDURE: assign a verdict to every criterion → weighted ratio per dimension → raw = Σ max(dim)×ratio → normalize to /16 → if ANY gate tripped, cap the normalized score at 0.40 and flag it.
